command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined"
pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt pytest httpx
npm ci --prefix backend
evidence: final combined workflow step conclusion success

step: Pin combined source and disposable service identities
evidence: final combined workflow step conclusion success

step: Apply existing backend and narrative migrations
command:
set -euo pipefail
(cd backend && npm run db:migrate) 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/node-migrations.log"
(cd ai-service && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" python -m alembic upgrade head) 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/alembic.log"
evidence: final combined workflow step conclusion success

step: Focused P2 HTTP guards and P1 manuscript service regression
command:
set -euo pipefail
pytest -q -o addopts= -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp="$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-focused" --junitxml="$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/focused.xml" tests/test_p2_bootstrap_guard.py tests/test_p2_bootstrap_pacing_compat.py tests/test_p2_json_bootstrap_compat.py tests/test_manuscript_bootstrap.py 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/focused.log"
evidence: final combined workflow step conclusion success

step: Real PostgreSQL A16 with durable before and after readbacks
command:
set -euo pipefail
pytest -o addopts= -vv -s -m postgres_integration --basetemp="$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-a16" --junitxml="$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/a16.xml" tests/test_p2_bootstrap_postgres.py 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/a16.log"
evidence: final combined workflow step conclusion success

step: Start real AI service with fake providers
command:
set -euo pipefail
python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 58001 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/ai-service.log" 2>&1 &
echo "$!" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/ai.pid"
for i in {1..30}; do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:58001/health; then exit 0; fi
  sleep 1
done
exit 1
evidence: final combined workflow step conclusion success

step: Gateway forwarding contracts and P1 save revision outbox acceptance
command:
set -euo pipefail
npx tsx --test src/modules/ai/ai-gateway.test.ts src/modules/ai/p1-closed-loop-gateway.test.ts 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/gateway-forwarding.log"
P2A_EVIDENCE_FILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/gateway-readbacks.json" npx tsx --test src/modules/ai/p2-bootstrap-guard.live.test.ts 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p2-combined/gateway-a16.log"
evidence: final combined workflow step conclusion success

step: Stop only the task AI process
